name: get_weather_forecast
description: Retrieve a multi-day weather forecast for a given location.

parameter.name: location
parameter.description: City name, postal code, or 'lat,lon' coordinates.

parameter.name: days
parameter.description: Number of forecast days to return, from 1 to 14.

name: get_current_conditions
description: Get the current real-time weather conditions at a location.

parameter.name: location
parameter.description: City name, postal code, or 'lat,lon' coordinates.

parameter.name: include_air_quality
parameter.description: Whether to include the current air quality index.

name: get_weather_alerts
description: List active severe weather alerts and warnings for a region.

parameter.name: region
parameter.description: State, province, or country code to query alerts for.

name: send_email

parameter.name: query
parameter.description: Full-text or filter query, e.g. 'from:alice invoice'.

parameter.description: Maximum number of messages to return.
